### 🏗️ Architecture Plan

**Tech Stack:**
- React (zero-build setup using ESM modules)
- Chart.js for visualizations
- React Context for state management
- Fetch API for REST communication

**Project Structure:**
```
/
├── src/
│   ├── ReportGenerator.jsx       # Main component
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── analysis/             # Analysis modes
│   │   │   ├── ChartView.jsx
│   │   │   ├── TableView.jsx
│   │   │   ├── StatsView.jsx
│   │   │   └── ComparisonView.jsx
│   │   ├── common/               # Shared components
│   │   │   ├── DataGrid.jsx
│   │   │   ├── FilterPanel.jsx
│   │   │   └── LoadingState.jsx
│   │   └── config/               # Configuration UI
│   │       ├── ApiConfig.jsx
│   │       └── AuthConfig.jsx
│   ├── context/                  # State management
│   │   ├── ReportContext.jsx
│   │   └── ConfigContext.jsx
│   ├── hooks/                    # Custom hooks
│   │   ├── useDataFetch.js
│   │   ├── useChartData.js
│   │   └── useTableFilters.js
│   ├── data/                     # Sample data
│   │   ├── users.json
│   │   └── products.json
│   └── utils/                    # Utilities
│       ├── dataTransforms.js
│       ├── chartHelpers.js
│       └── apiClient.js
├── tests/                        # Test suite
│   ├── setup.js
│   └── ReportGenerator.test.jsx
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

**Implementation Strategy:**

1. Core Setup (Phase 1)
   - Initialize package.json with minimal dependencies
   - Create ReportGenerator component shell
   - Set up Context providers
   - Implement basic configuration system

2. Data Layer (Phase 2)
   - Create API client utilities
   - Implement data fetching hooks
   - Add sample datasets
   - Build data transformation utilities

3. UI Components (Phase 3)
   - Implement the four analysis modes:
     a. Chart View (line, bar, pie charts)
     b. Table View (sortable, filterable)
     c. Stats View (key metrics, summaries)
     d. Comparison View (side-by-side analysis)
   - Add common components (grids, filters)

4. Features & Polish (Phase 4)
   - Add bearer token authentication
   - Implement real-time updates
   - Add error handling
   - Optimize performance

**Technical Decisions:**

1. Zero Build Setup:
   - Use ES modules directly
   - CDN-loaded dependencies
   - No transpilation required

2. State Management:
   - React Context for global state
   - Custom hooks for data fetching
   - Local state for UI components

3. Testing Setup:
   - Jest + React Testing Library
   - Component unit tests
   - Integration tests for data flow

4. Data Flow:
   - REST API integration
   - Client-side data transformation
   - Real-time updates via polling

Next steps for the Engineer:
1. Initialize package.json with core dependencies
2. Create the basic folder structure
3. Set up the ReportGenerator component shell
4. Implement the configuration system
5. Begin work on the data layer
